description: Japan's consumer price inflation (CPI, all items) — the metric the Bank of Japan targets at 2%. Returns the latest year-on-year inflation rate (%), the latest CPI index level, their month, and recent monthly history. Use for 'Japan inflation rate' / 'Japan CPI' / 'is Japan hitting the BOJ 2% target' questions. Sourced from IMF IFS (keyless).

months.description: How many recent months of history to return (default 12).

name: boj_inflation
